title: DPLEvolve: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA — Artifact Evaluation
description: Artifact Evaluation repository for 'From Tool Invocation to Source-Mechanism Exploration: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA'. Provides pinned EDA setup, fresh Table 4 and Table 6 experiment runners, 18 selected ReviewDSE source programs, ReviewDSE search scripts, figure generation, and numerical evaluation.
notes: A clean OpenROAD-flow-scripts workspace can be prepared with make bootstrap at the revisions recorded in provenance/source-commits.json. The paper run used a Teacher and four Student agents for 10 review iterations. See docs/claims-to-artifacts.md for the exact reproduction limits. Replace the placeholder creator with the paper's ordered author list before deposit.
